query:
INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, display_name, status, email_verified, roles)
        VALUES ($1, LOWER($2), LOWER($2), $2, 'active', true, $3)
        ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
            status = 'active',
            roles = EXCLUDED.roles,
            updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING id AS "id!: UserId"
